title: Peripapillary choroidal thickness after intravitreal ranibizumab injections in eyes with neovascular age-related macular degeneration

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License; CC0 waiver for data made available in the article)

condition: Treatment-naive neovascular AMD (type 2 or type 3 neovascularization; PCV, high myopia, glaucoma and prior PDT or intravitreal anti-VEGF excluded); retrospective case-control study (Korea University Medical Center, February 2011 to March 2013), 39 eyes of 39 patients; age-matched healthy control eyes not extracted

groups.description: Neovascular AMD eyes: three monthly ranibizumab injections, then monthly follow-up with retreatment as needed

exclusions.what: Table 3 subfoveal and peripapillary choroidal thickness rows
exclusions.reason: choroidal thickness is out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 3 peripapillary retinal thickness and RNFL rows
exclusions.reason: peripapillary/RNFL thickness, not central retinal thickness

exclusions.what: Tables 1, 2 and 4 (baseline characteristics, choroidal thickness comparisons with healthy controls, choroidal thickness by neovascularization type with medians/IQR for type 3)
exclusions.reason: not central retinal thickness series; healthy control eyes excluded
groups defined by a post-baseline outcome (3-month response); regression statistics

notes: Time origin: the first ranibizumab injection; mean 4.4 injections within 6 months (range 3-6)
SD-OCT Topcon 3D OCT-1000 Mark II (device topcon); central RT/CRT is not defined in the Methods (horizontal 6-mm line scans centred on the fovea), so measure central_unspecified

Image-quality exclusions (Q-factor < 45 or choroid not visible due to severe subfoveal haemorrhage; 3 low-quality cases among screened records) are measurement-quality exclusions; no values were removed or replaced after a treatment event
Neovascularization type: type 2 in 35 eyes, type 3 in 4 eyes; BCVA exists but is not extracted

series.notes: Mean ± SD (table footnote); data collected at baseline, 3 and 6 months after the first injection (nominal times); per-visit n not reported (paired t-tests)
